Each time I encountered an object that could be my partner, I stopped there and moved a bit around to see if it would try to search me. If the object follows me around during these small hops, I assume this is my partner.
I think my partner first searched around the space for me, then would stop at my position and then try to follow me as soon as he would identify me.
